scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator and two friends walk down a residential Amsterdam street towards the camera.
scene_timeline.audio_description: If you're going to Amsterdam, this is how you spend the perfect 24 hours in the city.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The group eats brunch at an outdoor cafe table with pancakes and burgers.
scene_timeline.audio_description: We woke up and walked to get brunch. Not gonna lie, this place was mid, so do your research before.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Montage of a large outdoor flea market featuring racks of vintage clothes and sunglasses.
scene_timeline.audio_description: After that, we headed over to this flea market, and this is a must-see. This place had everything: glasses, jewelry, their denim selection was actually insane.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Interior of a thrift store where the creator looks at a pinstripe blazer.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Then we went to this place called Kilo Store. It's basically this giant thrift shop, but they price everything off weight. I still regret not getting this jacket.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The group rents red bicycles from a rental shop.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Then you have to rent bikes. We went to this place called MacBike, and it was super smooth and easy.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The group visits the Heineken brewery, pours beers, and cheers with glasses.
scene_timeline.audio_description: We rode our bikes to the Heineken brewery and did the Heineken Experience. Here's a pro-tip: the tour isn't that cool, but they give you drink tokens to use at this bar at the end of the tour, and a bunch of people don't want their tokens, so you end up getting like 6 or 7 beers per person for the price of one.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The group eats at a crowded indoor food hall.
scene_timeline.audio_description: After that, we're feeling good, hop back on the bikes, and we biked to Foodhallen. This is a giant food market with a bunch of different styles of cuisine. All of it's really good.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Close up of a cup of pink and white gelato.
scene_timeline.audio_description: And then we got gelato at Massimo Gelato. Really good, definitely go.

scene_timeline.visual_description: Cinematic shots of the Amsterdam canals at sunset with a boat passing by.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Then we're back on the bikes, biking over to the canals to catch the sunset. Everything here looks like a movie set. It's ridiculous.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The group enters an ice bar, wears parkas, and drinks from ice glasses.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Once the sun is down, get changed and we're heading to an ice bar. I'm gonna be honest again: this looks way doper on camera than it is in person. It's kind of one of those things you have to do just to say that you did it, but like, it's freezing cold, you don't wanna spend a lot of time in there.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The group dances in a dark nightclub with green lasers and a DJ.
scene_timeline.audio_description: And then to cap the night off, you have to explore the nightlife. We hit a bunch of different bars and clubs, but this one's called Escape, and I would definitely recommend.
